Holam before vav

All 17 occurrences in 16 verses of MAM. A non-vav letter has a holam dot, and the next letter is vav; combining marks may intervene. The divine name, including prefixed occurrences, is excluded. Holam haser for vav is also excluded.

The blue text marks the holam-bearing letter and following vav. The original marks remain on their original letters. Hebrew is enlarged and spaced to make the mark placement easier to inspect.

Above-marks on the matched vav: zaqef qatan: 3; revia: 1.

The marks column names all marks on the matched vav. An accent on another letter does not put an occurrence in the first group.

BHL page numbers are the printed page numbers, checked against the verse text. Hover over a page number for its scan filename and inventory position. These locations do not imply agreement with MAM's pointing. In Nehemiah 6:6, the target is on page 1113 although that page's header begins at 6:7.
